English.name: Windows Central
English.description: Windows Central is a technology news site focused on Microsoft, Windows, Xbox, Surface, and related hardware and software. It publishes breaking news, reviews, guides, and opinion pieces, and is part of a larger portfolio of tech publications.

English.name: maia :3
English.description: A personal blog that frequently covers technology, security, privacy, and internet culture from an explicitly activist perspective. Like many personal outlets, topics can be idiosyncratic and opinionated, and the tone may vary from post to post.

English.name: Ars Technica
English.description: Ars Technica is a long-running technology publication known for in-depth reporting and analysis across software, hardware, security, science, and policy. It blends breaking tech news with detailed explainers and reviews aimed at a technically literate audience.

English.name: TechCrunch
English.description: TechCrunch focuses on startups, venture capital, and the technology business ecosystem. Coverage includes product launches, funding rounds, industry trends, and analysis of major tech companies and markets.

English.name: Engadget
English.description: Engadget covers consumer technology, including gadgets, mobile devices, computing, and product reviews. It mixes breaking news with hands-on coverage and buying advice for mainstream tech audiences.

English.name: Al Jazeera
English.description: Al Jazeera is an international news network best known for global and Middle East coverage. It produces a mix of breaking news, long-form reporting, and analysis across politics, conflict, and society.

Deutsch.name: heise online
Deutsch.description: heise online is a German technology news outlet covering IT, software, security, and the digital economy. It is widely read in German-speaking tech circles and publishes both news and deeper analysis.

Deutsch.name: Golem.de
Deutsch.description: Golem.de is a German-language tech publication focused on IT, software development, security, and digital policy. It targets professional readers with news, explainers, and industry reporting.

Deutsch.name: netzpolitik.org
Deutsch.description: netzpolitik.org is a German outlet focused on digital rights, surveillance, privacy, and internet policy. It blends reporting with advocacy-oriented analysis around civil liberties in the digital sphere.

United States.name: CNN
United States.description: CNN is a major US-based cable and digital news organization covering US politics, world affairs, business, and breaking news. It publishes fast-moving headline coverage along with analysis, opinion, and feature reporting.

United States.name: AP News
United States.tagline: Top headlines from The Associated Press.
United States.description: The Associated Press (AP) is a global news cooperative that supplies reporting to many other outlets. Its coverage emphasizes straight-news reporting, fast breaking updates, and broad geographic reach.

United States.name: NPR News
United States.description: NPR is a US public media network producing news, audio programs, and digital reporting. It is best known for radio and podcast journalism, with coverage spanning politics, culture, and international news.

United States.name: PBS NewsHour
United States.description: PBS NewsHour is a US public television news program known for longer-form interviews and explainers. Its reporting often emphasizes context and analysis over rapid headline churn.

United Kingdom.name: BBC News
United Kingdom.description: BBC News is the news division of the UK’s public broadcaster, covering UK and global events across politics, business, science, and culture. It combines breaking news with analysis and features, and is widely syndicated internationally.

United Kingdom.name: The Guardian (UK)
United Kingdom.description: The Guardian is a UK-based newspaper and digital outlet known for investigative reporting, commentary, and extensive political coverage. It has a strong presence online and publishes both UK-focused and international news.

United Kingdom.name: Sky News (UK)
United Kingdom.description: Sky News is a UK-based broadcast and digital news outlet covering UK politics, world news, and breaking stories. It produces rolling news coverage with a mix of live reporting and analysis.

Germany.name: DW
Germany.description: Deutsche Welle (DW) is Germany’s international public broadcaster. It publishes news and analysis in multiple languages, with coverage spanning Germany, Europe, and global politics.

Switzerland.name: SWI swissinfo.ch
Switzerland.description: SWI swissinfo.ch publishes Swiss news and explainers for an international audience, with a focus on Swiss politics, society, and direct democracy. It often provides context aimed at readers outside Switzerland.

Germany.name: DW (Deutsch)
Germany.description: Deutsche Welle (DW) ist Deutschlands internationaler öffentlich-rechtlicher Auslandsrundfunk. Die deutschsprachigen Feeds bündeln Nachrichten, Hintergründe und Analysen zu Deutschland, Europa und der Welt.

Germany.name: tagesschau.de
Germany.tagline: Nachrichten aus Deutschland und der Welt.
Germany.description: tagesschau.de ist der Nachrichtenauftritt der ARD und gehört zu den bekanntesten Nachrichtenmarken in Deutschland. Der Feed bietet aktuelle Meldungen, Politik- und Weltberichterstattung sowie Hintergrundstücke.

Germany.name: DER SPIEGEL (Top)
Germany.description: DER SPIEGEL ist ein deutsches Nachrichtenmagazin mit großer Online-Präsenz. Der Top-Feed enthält Schlagzeilen und wichtige Themen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalem Geschehen.

Switzerland.name: SRF News
Switzerland.description: SRF News ist der Nachrichtenbereich von Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen (SRF). Die Berichterstattung umfasst Schweiz-Themen, internationale Nachrichten sowie Hintergrund- und Erklärformate.

Switzerland.name: SWI swissinfo.ch
Switzerland.description: SWI swissinfo.ch veröffentlicht Schweizer Nachrichten und Analysen für ein internationales Publikum. Der deutschsprachige Feed bietet Einordnung zu Politik, Gesellschaft und internationalen Themen mit Schweiz-Bezug.
